---
title: "minimap"
---





`minimap` provides `purrr`-style mapping functions -- `mmap_map()`,
`mmap_map2()`, `mmap_imap()`, `mmap_walk()`, `mmap_iwalk()`, and the
type-stable `mmap_map_dbl()`/`mmap_map_lgl()`/`mmap_map_chr()` -- built
entirely on `lapply()`/`vapply()`. See the
[README](https://github.com/djnavarro/minis/tree/main/minimap) for the
full API reference and scope notes; this page walks through each in
action.

## `mmap_map()`

Applies a function to each element of a list or vector, always
returning a list, with names preserved:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mmap_map(1:3, function(x) x + 1)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[[1]]
[1] 2

[[2]]
[1] 3

[[3]]
[1] 4
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mmap_map(c(a = 1, b = 2), function(x) x * 10)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
$a
[1] 10

$b
[1] 20
```


:::
:::



## Type-stable variants

`mmap_map_dbl()`, `mmap_map_lgl()`, and `mmap_map_chr()` return an
atomic vector instead of a list, erroring if `.f` doesn't return a
length-1 value of the expected type for every element:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mmap_map_dbl(1:3, function(x) x + 1)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 2 3 4
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mmap_map_lgl(1:5, function(x) x %% 2 == 0)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] FALSE  TRUE FALSE  TRUE FALSE
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mmap_map_dbl(1:3, function(x) c(x, x))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-error}

```
Error in `vapply()`:
! values must be length 1,
 but FUN(X[[1]]) result is length 2
```


:::
:::



## `mmap_map2()` and `mmap_imap()`

`mmap_map2()` walks two same-length vectors in parallel:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mmap_map2(1:3, 4:6, function(x, y) x + y)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[[1]]
[1] 5

[[2]]
[1] 7

[[3]]
[1] 9
```


:::
:::



`mmap_imap()` walks a named vector together with its names, passing
`.f` the element then its name:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mmap_imap(c(a = 1, b = 2), function(val, name) paste0(name, "=", val))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
$a
[1] "a=1"

$b
[1] "b=2"
```


:::
:::



## `mmap_walk()` and `mmap_iwalk()`

Both run `.f` for its side effects only, returning `.x` invisibly:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mmap_walk(1:3, function(x) cat("value:", x, "\n"))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
value: 1 
value: 2 
value: 3 
```


:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mmap_iwalk(c(a = 1, b = 2), function(val, name) cat(name, "->", val, "\n"))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
a -> 1 
b -> 2 
```


:::
:::
